versions.changelog:
Initial release — daily AI ecosystem pulse on Claude Code and agent skill trends.

- Scans ClawHub trending skills, Hacker News (≥3 comments, 24h window with fallback), and X/Twitter builder chatter for signal.
- Synthesizes findings into a 5-bullet Markdown brief with sentiment tags, sources, and draft replies for engagement-worthy opportunities.
- Strict filters exclude recruiter spam (LinkedIn), academic noise (r/MachineLearning), and generic social posts.
- Implements tiered fallback queries for reliable coverage when sources are sparse.
- Designed for founders/builders needing an actionable morning skills briefing without multi-site searching.
